newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse halts Rizal price rise.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse halts Rizal price rise.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) froze the share price of Rizal Commercial Banking Corp (RCBC) on Thursday after it jumped 50 percent to 150 pesos from 100 pesos in mid-morning trade.

The PSE surveillance department said it will ask the bank to explain the surge in its price. The bourse freezes the price of any counter which climbs by or close to 50 percent in a single trading session.
The bourse said RCBC can only be traded at the price at which it was frozen. By late trade, 99,000 RCBC shares had changed hands.

Russell Ong, an Anscor Hagedorn Securities Inc analyst, said that the bank has not made any recent disclosures except for a 6.50 percent stock dividend to cover stockholders on record as of February 5.
Last week, the company said its stock dividend will be payable on March 5.
